**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Madam
The insurances existing are as follow
£360 in premises occupied by Hicks.
£1700 on Rising Sun & various cottages
£300 on House occupied by Mimksn [?]
I do not appear to have any insurances on your own House or the contents Shall I get you a Policy for it & contents or only for £200 on Contents
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](../persons.html#2094)
Miss Yonge
£200 seems to me rather a small sum
